gloss: food and drink bill; cost of eating out

definitions.gloss: food and drink bill; cost of eating out
definitions.explanation: The amount charged or spent on food and drink, typically at a restaurant, bar, or similar establishment.

examples.japanese: {飲食代|いんしょくだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧。
examples.english: To pay the food and drink bill.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{飲食代|いんしょくだい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧かさんだ。
examples.english: My eating-out costs piled up this month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧あと⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{飲食代|いんしょくだい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The company covers the food and drink costs after meetings.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{飲食|いんしょく}→飲食：03010_inshoku⟧ (eating and drinking) plus the suffix ⟦{代|だい}→〜代：28331_dai⟧ (charge, fee). Refers to the money spent on meals and drinks rather than to a single itemized check.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飲食代|いんしょくだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay the food and drink bill
- {飲食代|いんしょくだい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧かさむ: for eating-out costs to mount up
- {飲食代|いんしょくだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経費|けいひ}→経費：04696_keihi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧: to write off dining costs as expenses

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{飲|の}み{代|だい}→飲み代：29658_nomidai⟧: drinking expenses — limited to alcohol and bar tabs
- ⟦{食費|しょくひ}→食費：16477_shokuhi⟧: food expenses — everyday cost of groceries and meals, not eating out specifically
